opening: I am a student studying in the University of Hong Kong. I must choose my courses before the deadline. All of my courses were gone in one evening. What happened?
answer: I needed to attend a mandatory high table dinner and was asked to indicate which courses I prefer to eat before the deadline. In the evening when I attended the high table dinner, I arrived punctually. I did not finish every course in my three-course meal because I don't like its taste. Therefore I asked the waiter to collect the remains each time he serves the next course and thus my courses are eventually gone.
